simpledimension.guide.page.1.title: Simple Dimensions
simpledimension.guide.page.1: Configurable dimensions, light arches and safe linked portals.
simpledimension.guide.page.2.title: Skyblock
simpledimension.guide.page.2: Build one of six glowstone arches and place a separate emitting block within three blocks of the interior. Glowstone, fire, soul fire, and portal blocks do not count. Ignite with flint and steel or one fire charge.
simpledimension.guide.page.3.title: Skyblock
simpledimension.guide.page.3: The light blue void has a bedrock arrival island whose diameter is the frame width plus four, and an exact return exit. No free resources are generated.
simpledimension.guide.page.4.title: Mining Dimension
simpledimension.guide.page.4: Portal rows: DXXD / D..D / D..D / D..D / DEED. D is deepslate bricks, X diamond ore, E emerald ore. One origin block maps to two mining blocks.
simpledimension.guide.page.5.title: Mining Dimension
simpledimension.guide.page.5: The forest flat preset has bedrock at -64, deepslate through 0, stone through 188, dirt at 189–190, and grass at 191. Vanilla biome features provide ores and trees; terrain is never reset.
simpledimension.guide.page.6.title: Travel Dimension
simpledimension.guide.page.6: Portal rows: KRRK / O..O / O..O / O..O / SSSS. K is a wither skeleton skull, R resin bricks, O dark oak logs, S soul sand. Ten origin blocks map to one travel block. The flat bedrock plane grants no extra movement speed.
simpledimension.guide.page.7.title: Travel Dimension
simpledimension.guide.page.7: Generated exits keep exact origins rather than selecting nearby foreign portals.
simpledimension.guide.page.8.title: Portal Shapes
simpledimension.guide.page.8: The six default matrices are AGA/G.G/G.G; AGGA/G..G/G..G/G..G; AGGGA/G...G/G...G/G...G; AAGGAA/AG..GA/G....G/G....G/G....G; AAGGGAA/AG...GA/G.....G/G.....G/G.....G; AAGGGGAA/AG....GA/G......G/G......G/G......G.
simpledimension.guide.page.9.title: Portal Shapes
simpledimension.guide.page.9: A is checked air, G glowstone, and dots become portal cells. Both horizontal axes work. Breaking the frame or removing required light dissolves outbound portal cells.
simpledimension.guide.page.10.title: Safe Travel and Return
simpledimension.guide.page.10: Only unmounted players travel. Items, mobs, mounts, and passengers are refused. Target registries, borders, build height, solid ground, headroom, claim permissions, and an exact return path are checked.
simpledimension.guide.page.11.title: Safe Travel and Return
simpledimension.guide.page.11: Builds use only empty cells and bedrock; valuable frames are never copied. In terrain dimensions,
simpledimension.guide.page.12.title: Safe Travel and Return
simpledimension.guide.page.12: the platform is raised above every existing block in its bounded footprint, including nonblocking plants.
simpledimension.guide.page.13.title: Safe Travel and Return
simpledimension.guide.page.13: Vegetation and existing builds are preserved. One build per server tick, at most nine chunks per build and 1,024 recorded portals.
simpledimension.guide.page.14.title: Safe Travel and Return
simpledimension.guide.page.14: Warmup is 0–200 ticks, cooldown 20–1,200 ticks, and players must leave the portal after arrival. Generated exits remain usable when access is disabled.
simpledimension.guide.page.15.title: Safe Travel and Return
simpledimension.guide.page.15: Missing definitions or falling near the void floor invokes the persisted safe origin; otherwise a checked overworld spawn is used.
simpledimension.guide.page.16.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimension.guide.page.16: Server JSON: config/simpledimension/server.json. Portal definitions: config/simpledimension/dimensions/*.json; existing files are preserved.
simpledimension.guide.page.17.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimension.guide.page.17: The mandatory generated pack loads on both loaders before world registries.
simpledimension.guide.page.18.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimension.guide.page.18: At most 16 definitions, eight recipes each, 23×23 matrices, 21×21 interiors, eight extra origins, 64 KiB
simpledimension.guide.page.19.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimension.guide.page.19: per input file, and coordinate ratios 0.5–10. Generation height is 16–384 in 16-block steps, minimum Y -64–0.
simpledimension.guide.page.20.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimension.guide.page.20: Destinations stay in the isolated simpledimension namespace. New dimensions require a world restart. preset and orePreset are retained legacy labels without generation effects.
simpledimension.guide.page.21.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimension.guide.page.21: Access/Safety/Dimensions config tabs show defaults; multiplayer clients cannot edit server values. Nonplayer travel is reserved and permanently refused.
simpledimension.guide.page.22.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimension.guide.page.22: Known claim mods require a registered permission integration; no claim bypass is offered. The Dimensions tab controls Skyblock, Mining, and Travel independently, all On by default.
simpledimension.guide.page.23.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimension.guide.page.23: These server settings persist in server.json and apply immediately to the local integrated server. Dedicated servers read them at startup; remote clients cannot change them.
simpledimension.guide.page.24.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimension.guide.page.24: Disabling access preserves dimension data and generated return portals. The old enabled flag in built-in dimension definitions is ignored; it remains supported for custom definitions.
simpledimension.guide.page.25.title: Server Claim Permissions
simpledimension.guide.page.25: Enabled Simple Tweaks claims are checked through the public framework API. Activation checks every frame and interior cell;
simpledimension.guide.page.26.title: Server Claim Permissions
simpledimension.guide.page.26: travel checks the source, linked destination, landing, and every generated platform cell. Disabled or absent Simple Tweaks adds no restrictions.

quests.simpledimension.start.welcome.des: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Dimensions Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and flint and steel.
